__doc__: Node Single Executable Application (SEA) config for the Meerkat Host companion (Plan 20, Phase 4.4). `node --experimental-sea-config host/build/sea-config.json` produces the blob that build.mjs injects into a copied `node` binary. The bundled main is a compiled snapshot of bin/meerkat-host.mjs; the relay/community/seeder bins + host/ui assets are carried as SEA assets. Cross-OS builds + code-signing/notarization are FOUNDER-OPS (see README.md); this repo does not claim to produce signed per-OS installers.
